purpose: Route every registered gravity/time/light concept to the theoretical, synthetic, source, and observational gates appropriate to its actual ontology without forcing waves, carriers, quantum states, media, memory, or emergent ideas into a radial formula score.

gate_vocabulary.question: Are units, invariant variables, limits, and equivalence class explicit?
What fields, particles, waves, states, media, or discrete objects exist?
How do baryons, radiation, clocks, and other sectors source or couple to it?
Are the evolution, constraint, integral, stochastic, or quantum operators complete?
Are boundary, initial, gauge, and constraint data well posed?
Does it pass the synthetic fixtures appropriate to its claims?
Is there an independently checked full 3-D or spacetime implementation?
Are rotations, translations, coordinates, frames, and symmetry reductions consistent?
Is an action or explicit exchange ledger available and are conserved quantities derived?
Are physical degrees of freedom and constraints counted?
Are characteristics and the principal symbol derived?
Are kinetic and gradient matrices healthy on declared backgrounds?
Is energy bounded or is the instability explicitly controlled?
Do matter, light, gravity, and extra modes share a viable causal initial-value structure?
What radiates, at what speed, with what polarizations and damping?
Where does perturbation theory or the effective description fail?
Where claimed, are Hilbert space, observables, probabilities, unitarity, and classical limit defined?
Is matter motion or capture derived without inserting dissipation by hand?
Are null propagation, lensing, and frequency shift derived from the same completion?
Are local clock rates separated from path accumulation and cosmological redshift?
Does the same branch recover Solar-System and parametrized post-Newtonian limits?
Does it pass strong-field timing and radiation-loss requirements?
Does it admit a regular background and perturbation history?
Are source maps, geometry, environment, and uncertainty available without response leakage?
Are all upstream gates sufficient to authorize a target-blind observational test?

route_rules.all_mechanisms: TG01-TG08 and TG18-TG20 are always routed; TG24-TG25 remain blocked until real full-3D source and upstream gates pass.
route_rules.dynamical_completion: TG09-TG16 are required for any mechanism claiming a dynamical fundamental field, wave, carrier, metric, medium, or spacetime completion.
route_rules.quantum_claim: TG17 is required only for QG03, QG04, QG07, QG08, QG10, QG11, QG12 and any future card making a quantum claim.
route_rules.precision_regimes: TG21-TG23 are required before a universal gravitational theory can be promoted beyond a bounded phenomenological model.
route_rules.phenomenology_boundary: A static algebraic formula may mark dynamical or quantum gates NOT_APPLICABLE_CURRENT_SCOPE only while explicitly refusing a fundamental-theory claim; promotion makes them required.
route_rules.counterexample_policy: Any failure is retained at the exact gate and does not globally eliminate a broader ontology family.

matrix_contract.ordering: mechanism catalog order then TG01-TG25 order

establishes: complete deterministic gate routing for all 420 current mechanisms
which theory artifact must exist before each type of claim
does_not_establish: that routed gates have been executed unless explicitly bound
that any mechanism is healthy, observationally preferred, novel, or publication ready
